configuration.title: InfiniAI Provider for VS Code
configuration.plan.description: Select the InfiniAI billing plan. When set to 'standard', the extension uses 'infiniai.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl'. When set to 'coding', it uses 'infiniai.coding.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl' instead, along with a separate API key.
configuration.plan.enum.standard: Pay-per-token billing. Uses 'infiniai.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.anthropic.baseUrl' for API requests.
configuration.plan.enum.coding: Coding Plan subscription. Uses 'infiniai.coding.baseUrl' and 'infiniai.coding.anthropic.baseUrl' for API requests, with a separate API key.
configuration.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (Standard Plan). The extension appends '/chat/completions' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.anthropic.baseUrl.descript: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API (Standard Plan). The extension appends '/v1/messages' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.coding.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (Coding Plan). The extension appends '/chat/completions' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.coding.anthropic.baseUrl.d: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan). The extension appends '/v1/messages' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.retry.description: Retry configuration for retryable network failures and HTTP [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
configuration.retry.enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.
configuration.retry.maxAttempts.descript: Maximum total number of attempts, including the first request. Default is 3.
configuration.retry.intervalMs.descripti: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 second).
configuration.retry.statusCodes.descript: Additional HTTP status codes to merge with the default retryable list [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
configuration.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).
configuration.modelDiscoveryUrl.descript: Optional absolute URL for model discovery. Empty uses the selected InfiniAI plan default.
configuration.modelCacheTtlMs.descriptio: How long to cache discovered models. Set 0 to refresh every request.
configuration.hiddenModels.description: Provider-level InfiniAI model IDs hidden from the VS Code chat model picker. Hidden models remain visible in the InfiniAI Models view and can be shown again from there.
configuration.hiddenModelPatterns.descri: Provider-level InfiniAI model ID patterns hidden from the VS Code chat model picker by default. Supports '*' wildcards and case-insensitive matching. Defaults hide image/video generation model families such as vidu, seedream, seedance, image, diffusion, hailuo, and kling.
configuration.visibleModels.description: Provider-level InfiniAI model IDs forced visible in the VS Code chat model picker, overriding 'infiniai.hiddenModels' and 'infiniai.hiddenModelPatterns'.
configuration.modelRoutes.description: Route matching overrides for model transports. The first matching pattern wins.
configuration.imageInputModels.descripti: Force-enable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns (e.g. 'kimi-*'). Useful when a multimodal model doesn't include a name marker like '-vision'.
configuration.disableImageInputModels.de: Force-disable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns.
configuration.disableThinkingForModels.d: Safety list. Thinking mode is force-disabled for matching model IDs to avoid known reasoning_content HTTP 400 errors. The built-in safety defaults always include known Xiaomi MiMo V2 model IDs and the DeepSeek V4 family. Usually leave this unchanged; add patterns only when another model has the same issue. Supports '*' wildcards; comparisons are case-insensitive.
configuration.enableThinkingRoundTripFor: Experimental opt-in that works with infiniai.disableThinkingForModels. The disable list is the safety default: matching models have thinking turned off. If the same model also matches this setting, the extension may keep thinking enabled only when replay preflight can prove the required reasoning_content is available; otherwise it fails locally to avoid HTTP 400. Useful for trying models such as 'mimo-v2*' or 'deepseek-v4*'. Supports '*' wildcards; comparisons are case-insensitive. Replay storage is controlled by infiniai.thinkingReplayStore.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.descri: Storage backend for experimental thinking replay after a model matches infiniai.enableThinkingRoundTripForModels. 'localPlaintext' persists replay data in a local plaintext extension-storage file for restart continuity. 'memory' writes no replay data to disk and cannot resume thinking tool-call conversations after VS Code reload or restart.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.enum.l: Default. Store replay data in a local plaintext extension-storage file so opted-in thinking tool-call conversations can continue after VS Code reload or restart while cache entries remain valid.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.enum.m: Keep replay data only in process memory. No replay cache file is written, but thinking tool-call conversations cannot be resumed after VS Code reload or restart.
